name: Main X Index (main-x-service)
summary: A federated identity index: ~55 self-contained Rust crates (loco.rs backend services + SvelteKit operator front-ends), one per real-world entity (person, worker, place, thing, event, course, organization, care pathway, case, plan/portfolio), each doing CRUD, probabilistic + deterministic matching, full-text search, record merge, an audit trail, and event streaming — plus a central SSO provider, a cross-service link-graph aggregator, and five consumer applications that build on the registries.
notes: Each crate is self-contained (own REST API, own persistence, own matching algorithm) and shares an architecture and documentation layout, not code. Every subproject's spec/ directory is the single source of truth for that subproject; code conforms to the spec, not the reverse.
